class: Failed authentication mistaken for no page transition
site: Rocket Software Workday; any registration/sign-in helper that changes account state before returning failure
symptom: Rocket run 20261022_101222 navigated from registration to refused Sign In, but the reader continued using page_02 registration refs on page_03. Runtime reported Invalid frame in aria-ref selector for email and consent and unnecessarily invoked AI before verification recovery.
root_cause: sign_in_step returned False when handle_auth_gate failed, even if its nested sign-in replaced the page. The outer loop interpreted False with no blocker as permission to answer the old controls.
why_tests_missed: Authentication tests covered success, unchanged failure, and recovery decisions separately. They did not exercise a helper returning False after replacing the live page.
fix: After an unsuccessful account action with no explicit blocker, inspect the current URL and account state. A transition returns progress so the outer loop rereads controls; unreadable state produces a precise handoff. This does not treat authentication as successful, retry credentials, or change reset/verification policy.
prevention: Represent interaction outcome and page transition separately. Test failed actions that navigate or render a new step, and invalidate old element references before planning further actions.
